output.summary: An annual daisy-family plant, pineappleweed has button-like yellowish-green flower heads without outer ray flowers, and its crushed flowers and foliage smell strongly of pineapple. Its washed greens are eaten, including in salads, though they may become bitter by flowering; the flowers or whole plant are also steeped as tea.
output.edibilityNote: Washed greens are eaten or used in salads but may become bitter by flowering; flowers and the whole plant are steeped for tea.
